title: Iowa Office of Consumer Advocate submits request to update the official service list under EL26-70.

documents.text:
September 15, 2026


VIA E-FILING

Honorable Debbie-Anne A. Reese Secretary
Federal Energy Regulatory Commission
888 First Street, N.E.
Washington, D.C. 20426

Re:	Iowa Office of Consumer Advocate’s Request to Update Service List, Docket No. EL26-70-000

Dear Secretary Reese:

Pursuant to Rule 2010(c)(2) of the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission’s Rules of Practice and Procedure, the Iowa Office of the Consumer Advocate respectfully submits this update to add the following individuals to the official service list in Docket No. EL26-70-000. 

ADD
	Heather L. Palmer
Attorney
Office of Consumer Advocate of Iowa	
1375 East Court Avenue			
Des Moines, IA 50319-0063			
(515) 725-7217 				
heather.palmer@oca.iowa.gov 

Please contact me at your convenience should you have any questions regarding this submission.	

Respectfully,

/s/ Heather L. Palmer
Heather L. Palmer

Attorney for the Iowa Office of Consumer Advocate

CERTIFICATE OF SERVICE
I hereby certify that I have this day served the foregoing document upon each person designated on the official service list compiled by the Secretary in this proceeding.
Dated at this 15th day of September, 2026.

/s/ Heather L. Palmer
Heather L. Palmer
Attorney
Office of Consumer Advocate of Iowa	
1375 East Court Avenue			
Des Moines, IA 50319-0063			
(515) 725-7217
